label: 🏝️ Puerto Rico
description: Choose roles to develop your island, produce goods, and ship them for victory points. Every role helps your rivals too, so timing matters as much as building a strong economy. This adaptation of Puerto Rico 1897: Special Edition includes all six expansions and solo play against two Puertomas.
credits:

**Publishers:** [Awaken Realms](https://awakenrealms.com/games/awaken-realms/puerto-rico) and [alea / Ravensburger](https://www.ravensburger.com/).

**Solo design:** John Albertson, Xavi Bordes, David Digby, Nick Shaw, and Dávid Turczi.
